source_title: NASA Lunar Surface Data Book, ACD-50044 Revision A (May 2023), NTRS 20230007818

candidates.name: CR1
candidates.represents: Assumed landing point in a notional traverse study, section 7.3.3, p.46

candidates.name: C2
candidates.represents: Endpoint of a notional logistics-transfer traverse, Figure 0.1, p.38

selection_rationale: CR1 has an explicit coordinate tuple and a clear hypothetical landing role in NASA section 7.3.3. C2 is documented but only a logistics-traverse endpoint. Both fit the existing raster footprints. Choose CR1 for source clarity, a location much closer to the pole than Athena, and cached terrain suitability, before computing any coverage skyline or visibility. No illumination or communications results used to rank candidates.
pipeline_frame_assumption: ME/DE421 body-fixed, planetocentric latitude, east-positive longitude, following cached LOLA labels; equivalence to source coordinate frame not demonstrated
point_status: study location / hypothetical landing point; not an observed landing or a designated mission destination
coordinate_accuracy: not stated; published decimal places are not a measured uncertainty
source_exclusions: Appendix A2.1 polygon center coordinates and its 5-10 m statement do not describe this selected tuple and were not substituted. Nearby Connecting Ridge C1/CR1 tuples in other studies are not interchangeable.
